prompt: Complete the sentence about where Redis Cloud performs persistence when replication is enabled.
explanation: When replication is enabled for a database, Redis Cloud performs persistence against the replicas to reduce the performance impact on the primary. The data is still copied to persistent storage attached to the underlying cloud instances; the setting only changes which copy of the data does the disk work.
